task_name: Add configurable private storage and multipart upload foundation

concerns_addressed: PHASE-003 is resolved by correction commit 6f05584: the multipart contract now reserves exactly one JSON metadata field named metadata, with one metadata part and bounded card-create and existing-card profiles.

The correction is limited to server/src/lib/attachment-upload.ts and server/src/lib/attachment-storage.test.ts; it does not alter log.json, route code, storage location, or the existing provider boundary.

strengths: CARD_CREATE_METADATA_FIELD and ATTACHMENT_METADATA_PARTS make the one-field JSON metadata contract explicit and exported for downstream route composition.

The derived profiles preserve card-create maxPairs 3/files 6/parts 7/fileSize 10MB and existing-card maxPairs 10/files 20/parts 21/fileSize 10MB; the Multer sentinel correctly rejects the first part beyond each documented ceiling.

Real multipart tests accept one metadata part with all three card-create pairs, reject duplicate metadata before provider invocation, preserve four-pair existing-card partial capacity, reject the 21st file and excess parts, and retain the 10MB file-size boundary.

The correction commit changes only the upload contract and its focused tests; no diskStorage, public path, new dependency, route code, or log.json change was introduced. The focused suite passes all 8 tests and server typecheck passes.

issues.description: The configuration test covers the container default using NODE_ENV=production but does not directly exercise the literal NODE_ENV=container-production branch, leaving that equivalent branch without an explicit regression test.
